title: Crispy Ethiopian Mozzarella Fritters
description: A unique twist on traditional fritters, infused with the flavors of Ethiopia. Crunchy on the outside and gooey on the inside.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, combine jjigae, nutty, crispy, and mozzarella.
In a separate bowl, beat eggs. Add to the dry ingredients and mix well.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
